title: Meta is putting its muscle behind Muse as the AI app takes off
slides: Meta just bet big on Muse, but why now?
Its AI app is quietly climbing the charts
Users stay longer than anyone expected
Your feed may soon be run by models you never chose
Check one feed today — notice what feels off
thread_text:
1. Meta's Quiet AI Bet

Muse just became Meta's biggest AI priority, and the timing isn't random. The app's retention numbers are climbing faster than any internal forecast predicted.

2. Climbing Without Noise

While everyone watched ChatGPT, Meta's AI app kept gaining users. It's already ranking high in app stores without a single splashy launch.

3. The Retention Surprise

People are staying in Meta's AI longer than expected. That session data is the real signal — not downloads, not hype.

4. Your Feed, Their Models

Meta is testing AI-curated feeds that pick posts using models you never opted into. You won't see a toggle or a warning.

5. Check Your Feed Today

Open your feed and notice what feels off. Then ask: did I choose this, or did a model choose it for me?
